Question 4
?

The sides (in inches) of a square are increasing. At a particular moment, the rate of increase of the area of the square is numerically equal to eleven times the rate of increase of the sides. What is the area of the square at that moment?

a
30 in2
b
30.25 in2
c
30.05 in2
d
35.2 in2
e
32.5 in2
